study.design: retail survey of frozen imported and domestic fish fillets, randomly selected batches, 10 samples per batch
study.origin: China (Pacific cod, as stated by vendors)

period.as_reported: collection period not stated; published September 2025

study.method: Microwave HNO3 digestion; ICP-AES for Ni, Cr, Al (hydride generation for As); GF-AAS for Pb and Cd; CV-AAS for Hg; MODAS-3 CRM
lod: LOQ µg/kg: Pb 3.1, Cd 1.1, Hg 5.2, As 1.0, Ni 4.1, Al 18.8, Cr 4.5 (Table 6)
